predict.M-G8PAREN: every VDP()/BASE()/SPRITE$() index -> ERR 2: most of Q1, Q2 and the SPRITE$ half of N/P; Q3 ie_off too (VDP(1) never clears the IE bit). PUT SPRITE's own (x,y) is parse_coord, NOT this routine, so the attr_* rows should NOT move.
predict.M-PUTCOMMA: every PUT SPRITE that carries arguments -> ERR 2: all of N's attr_* rows and O's put_* rows except put_bare/put_comma, which are ERR 2 on both sides already.
predict.M-SPRSCR0: N's pattern rows and P's SPRITE$ rows; O spr_scr0_wr, spr_scr1_wr, spr_n255, spr_numeric, spr_noparen, spr_noeq. spr_n256/spr_n_neg should NOT move -- ERR 5 either way.
predict.M-VDPMIRR: every Q1 row that compares registers (17), plus Q2's read-back rows rd_vdp1 / wr_vfrac / wr_vnegfrac / wr_v255fr / g_self / g_mid_stmt / g_if_stmt.
predict.M-SPRSZAPL: the 16x16 rows N pat_16_*/read_16/attr_16_*, O put_pat64_16/put_pat63_16, P size_persist/size_persist0/size_mag3. size_mag and size_back should NOT move.
predict.M-SPRPBASE: every N pattern row (pat_8_*, pat_16_*, read_*), P pat_survives, cls_keeps, size_persist. The attr_* rows read the ATTRIBUTE table and should NOT move.
predict.M-SPRXREST: P init_planes, init_forclr, cls_keeps (the table is read after a mode set). N's attr_* rows overwrite all four bytes of plane 0 and should mostly survive.
predict.M-SPRENTSZ: N pat_16_full/pat_16_short/pat_16_wrap/read_16, P size_persist/size_persist0/size_mag3. size_back and size_mag should NOT move (entry is 8 either way).
predict.M-BASESHIFT: ONLY the SCREEN 0 reprograms -- s0_name, s0_satr, s0_spat, s0_desync. Groups 2 and 3 hold pattern base $0000, and 0>>11 == 0>>12, so their R4 is unchanged.
predict.M-SPRECLK: N attr_neg_x, attr_neg_x32, attr_work. attr_ec_clear should NOT move -- its second statement re-writes a positive x.
predict.M-SPRPATSC: N attr_16_pat1, attr_16_pat63. O put_pat63_16 should NOT move: accepted either way.
predict.M-BASEGRAIN: Q2 b_name_80 only (b_name_ok / b_name_odd are the controls and should NOT move).
